experiment_matrix.mixed_and_losing_merge_candidates: independent dev only, unless extra budget

failure_policy.rerun_rule: only verified infrastructure failures, same task/seed/model/config, first valid result retained; preserve all costs
failure_policy.model_failure_rule: no answer-selection reruns; official grader scores saved artifacts, including timeout/invalid/missing artifacts
failure_policy.unresolved_infrastructure: retain expected denominator and list failures; conservative zero score only as an explicitly labelled auxiliary result
failure_policy.native_aggregate_missing_behavior: never silently exclude invalid evaluations and call result complete
failure_policy.request_retries: Scope: evaluated-policy main/helper requests only; Judge retries follow judge_retry_rule and benchmark Judge settings. At most2 HTTP attempts total for each logical request, in one layer only; inner SDK/LiteLLM retries disabled. Retry only explicit connection failure before request was sent or429 confirming no generation. Same payload/seed and original remaining deadline. No read-timeout/ambiguous disconnect/response-length retry.
failure_policy.judge_retry_rule: score frozen original response/artifact; never regenerate model answers because a judge failed
failure_policy.native_agent_feedback: Original parser/tool-error feedback may create subsequent native agent turns within one trial; they are logged and count against the same wall clock. This is distinct from same-request transport retry.
failure_policy.output_truncation: Record finish_reason=length and partial text/tool/program artifacts, no higher-cap retry or second single-turn answer.
failure_policy.context_failure: Do not silently delete task text/images/history; apply exact guard and the locked Terminus proactive helper policy. Preserve failure and denominator.

Required adapters and end-to-end resource/long-context acceptance remain unimplemented or unverified. requirements_compliance.report_rule: Do not label the reduced Terminal configuration as satisfying the takehome-required 256K/80K/3h/32CPU/48GB setting. Full task coverage is preserved; configuration compliance is separate.

request_contract.counting: Count final serialized Qwen chat template plus actual processor-expanded visual tokens, tool definitions and pending messages, before each main/helper call. Require P+8192<=65536.
request_contract.end_of_generation: Native EOS/tool-call termination, no invented stop sequences; cap is an upper bound.
request_contract.context_overflow: Do not send over-budget requests, silently truncate input, drop images, lower output reservation or retry with larger budget. Preserve artifacts and budget failure.
request_contract.length_finish: Save partial response and finish_reason=length. No same-prompt re-generation or cap increase. Native multi-turn parser/tool error feedback may continue as a new logged agent turn within the original deadline; single-turn HLE/ASI do not generate a second answer.
request_contract.reasoning_mode: No hidden think generation; visible task explanation and Terminus analysis/plan fields remain valid output. Do not strip model output to conceal mode violations.

scheduling.benchmark_mode: Run one benchmark/model block at a time; all compared models use the same limits.
scheduling.timer_start: After environment/input preparation and admission to a solver slot; includes input handling, all endpoint waiting, transport attempts, generation, helpers and tool/program execution. Unadmitted global job queue is outside the per-task solver timer.
scheduling.timer_stop: Cancel in-flight generation, kill solver process group/container, retain current artifacts; cleanup is logged and cannot perform additional solving.
outside_solver_deadline: cleanup with no additional model action
scheduling.acceptance: Long-request peak memory, model queue latency and sandbox CPU/RAM enforcement must pass before formal runs. Eight admitted tasks is a frozen starting policy, not a measured sustainable throughput claim.

model_server_resources.scope: one serving allocation; independent CPU task environments separate; at most4 project H100 including all active jobs

judge_policy.scope: 8192 uniform cap applies to evaluated-model solver/helper calls only; grader calls retain separately fixed original/output budgets.
judge_policy.hle: DeepSeek official deepseek-flash, non-thinking,temperature0,max_tokens4096, fixed original criteria and JSON wrapper; experimental substitution.
judge_policy.asi: DeepSeek official deepseek-flash replacing upstream GPT5.5; preserve each task rubric,weights,num_judges,vision inputs,output cap and official local aggregation.
judge_policy.backup: Luna is not mixed into a frozen result batch; any provider change needs versioning and regrade of the same saved artifacts for every compared model.
judge_policy.calibration: Scientific text/image semantic calibration and scorer adapter acceptance required; interface success alone is insufficient.
judge_policy.failure: Retry judge on the identical frozen response/artifact only; never generate a new policy answer.
